title: A local flux obstruction to guidance in Laloë’s point-source collapse model
description: A mathematical-physics note on Bohmian guidance in the point-density reading of Laloë’s gravitational collapse model. A moving-neighborhood estimate identifies an incompatibility between the required flux and regular on-source phase guidance. Includes the moving-source proof, its regularity assumptions, a frozen-source check and a finite-width comparison.
